Overview: The aim is to investigate how adding noise affects the detection of remarkable points (zero crossings, local maxima, and minima), then use a low-pass filter to reduce that noise.

| Subsection | Task | Reused code |
|---|---|---|
| 4.1 Create the noisy signal | Generate white noise, add it to the original signal, and plot it. | Original signal from Section 3.1 and `plot_signal()` from Section 2. |
| 4.2 Remarkable points | Detect zero crossings, local maxima, and minima, and analyze the effects of noise. | Detection and plotting functions from Section 2 and frequency calculation from Section 3.3. |
| 4.3 Low-pass filter | Apply a Butterworth filter and compare the filtered and noisy signals. | `butter`, `filtfilt`, and previous analysis functions. |
